summary_en: This study compares two treatments after lumpectomy for low-risk breast cancer in women age 65 and older: accelerated partial breast irradiation alone, or endocrine therapy alone. Accelerated partial breast irradiation is given as 5 fractions every other day to the lumpectomy cavity, and endocrine therapy is chosen by the treating medical oncologist with an aim of 5 years, as tolerated. The main outcome is quality of life at 1 year after lumpectomy, and this is a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio compara dos tratamientos después de la lumpectomía en mujeres de 65 años o más con cáncer de mama de bajo riesgo: radioterapia parcial acelerada de la mama sola, o terapia endocrina sola. La radioterapia parcial acelerada se administra en 5 fracciones, un día sí y otro no, en la cavidad de la lumpectomía. La terapia endocrina la elige el oncólogo tratante, con una duración objetivo de 5 años, según la tolerancia de la paciente. El resultado principal es la calidad de vida a 1 año después de la lumpectomía, y es un estudio de fase 2.
who_for: Women age 65 or older with newly diagnosed invasive breast cancer.
Pathological T1 stage tumor, grade 1 or 2, and node-negative.
Estrogen or progesterone receptor positive (at least 10%).
HER2 negative by the stated lab criteria.
Breast-conserving surgery completed, with final margins of at least 2 mm and no lymphovascular invasion.
not_for: Chemotherapy before or after surgery during the study.
Current anti-hormone treatment, or hormone replacement not stopped within 30 days of randomization.
Multifocal or multicentric tumor, or synchronous bilateral breast cancer.
Clinical or imaging evidence of distant spread, or prior breast or thoracic radiation.
Autoimmune conditions with radiation risks, or uncontrolled medical conditions.
